versos.hebraico: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִבְנֵי־קֹ֬רַח מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ בְּאָזְנֵ֬ינוּ שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵ֥ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָ֑נוּ פֹּ֥עַל פָּעַ֥לְתָּ בִֽ֝ימֵיהֶ֗ם בִּ֣ימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃

controles.web: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us, what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
controles.kjv: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
controles.livre: Ó Deus, com nossos ouvidos ouvimos, nossos pais nos contaram a obra que tu fizeste nos seus dias, nos dias antigos.

versos.hebraico: אַתָּ֤ה׀ יָדְךָ֡ גּוֹיִ֣ם ה֭וֹרַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵ֑ם תָּרַ֥ע לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃

controles.web: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
controles.kjv: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
controles.livre: Para plantá-los, expulsaste as nações com a tua própria mão; para fazê-los crescer, afligiste os povos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א בְחַרְבָּ֡ם יָ֥רְשׁוּ אָ֗רֶץ וּזְרוֹעָם֮ לֹא־הוֹשִׁ֪יעָ֫ה לָּ֥מוֹ כִּֽי־יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וּ֭זְרוֹעֲךָ וְא֥וֹר פָּנֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣י רְצִיתָֽם׃

controles.web: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
controles.kjv: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
controles.livre: Porque não conquistaram a terra pelas espadas deles, nem o braço deles os salvou; mas sim tua mão direita e o teu braço, e a luz de teu rosto; porque tu os favoreceste.

versos.hebraico: אַתָּה־ה֣וּא מַלְכִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים צַ֝וֵּ֗ה יְשׁוּע֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃

controles.web: You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!
controles.kjv: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
controles.livre: Deus, tu és meu Rei; ordena salvações a Jacó.

versos.hebraico: בְּ֭ךָ צָרֵ֣ינוּ נְנַגֵּ֑חַ בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ נָב֥וּס קָמֵֽינוּ׃

controles.web: Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, will we tread them under who rise up against us.
controles.kjv: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
controles.livre: Por ti venceremos nossos adversários; por teu nome passaremos por cima dos que se levantam contra nós.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א בְקַשְׁתִּ֣י אֶבְטָ֑ח וְ֝חַרְבִּ֗י לֹ֣א תוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
controles.kjv: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
controles.livre: Porque minha confiança não está em meu arco; nem minha espada me salvará.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י ה֭וֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵ֥ינוּ הֱבִישֽׁוֹתָ׃

controles.web: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
controles.kjv: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
controles.livre: Pois tu nos salvaste de nossos adversários, e envergonhaste aos que nos odeiam.

versos.hebraico: בֵּֽ֭אלֹהִים הִלַּלְ֣נוּ כָל־הַיּ֑וֹם וְשִׁמְךָ֓׀ לְעוֹלָ֖ם נוֹדֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃

controles.web: In God we have made our boast all day long, we will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.
controles.kjv: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
controles.livre: Nós exaltamos a Deus o dia todo; e louvaremos o teu nome para sempre. (Selá)

versos.hebraico: אַף־זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵ֑נוּ וְלֹא־תֵ֝צֵ֗א בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

controles.web: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
controles.kjv: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
controles.livre: Mas agora tu tens nos rejeitado e envergonhado; e tu não tens saído junto com nossos exércitos.

versos.hebraico: תְּשִׁיבֵ֣נוּ אָ֭חוֹר מִנִּי־צָ֑ר וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֵ֗ינוּ שָׁ֣סוּ לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
controles.kjv: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
controles.livre: Tu nos fazes fugir do adversário, e aqueles que nos odeiam saqueiam de nós para si.

versos.hebraico: תִּ֭תְּנֵנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן מַאֲכָ֑ל וּ֝בַגּוֹיִ֗ם זֵרִיתָֽנוּ׃

controles.web: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
controles.kjv: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
controles.livre: Tu nos entregas como ovelhas para serem comidas, e nos espalhas entre as nações.

versos.hebraico: תִּמְכֹּֽר־עַמְּךָ֥ בְלֹא־ה֑וֹן וְלֹ֥א־רִ֝בִּ֗יתָ בִּמְחִירֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
controles.kjv: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
controles.livre: Tu vendes a teu povo ao preço de nada, e não aumentas o seu valor.

versos.hebraico: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃

controles.web: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
controles.kjv: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
controles.livre: Tu nos pões como humilhação por nossos vizinhos; como escárnio e zombaria pelos que estão ao redor de nós.

versos.hebraico: תְּשִׂימֵ֣נוּ מָ֭שָׁל בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם מְנֽוֹד־רֹ֝֗אשׁ בַּל־אֻמִּֽים׃

controles.web: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
controles.kjv: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
controles.livre: Tu nos pões como provérbio de escárnio entre as nações; como balançar de cabeça entre os povos;

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִ֣י נֶגְדִּ֑י וּבֹ֖שֶׁת פָּנַ֣י כִּסָּֽתְנִי׃

controles.web: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
controles.kjv: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
controles.livre: Minha humilhação está o dia todo diante de mim; e a vergonha cobre o meu rosto,

versos.hebraico: מִ֭קּוֹל מְחָרֵ֣ף וּמְגַדֵּ֑ף מִפְּנֵ֥י א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃

controles.web: At the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
controles.kjv: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
controles.livre: Pela voz do adversário e do que insulta; por causa do inimigo e do vingador.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־זֹ֣את בָּ֭אַתְנוּ וְלֹ֣א שְׁכַחֲנ֑וּךָ וְלֹֽא־שִׁ֝קַּ֗רְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: All this has come on us, yet have we not forgotten you, Neither have we been false to your covenant.
controles.kjv: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
controles.livre: Tudo isto veio sobre nós; porém não nos esquecemos de ti, nem traímos o teu pacto.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־נָס֣וֹג אָח֣וֹר לִבֵּ֑נוּ וַתֵּ֥ט אֲשֻׁרֵ֗ינוּ מִנִּ֥י אָרְחֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
controles.kjv: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
controles.livre: Nosso coração não se voltou para trás, nem nossos passos de desviaram de teu caminho.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י דִ֭כִּיתָנוּ בִּמְק֣וֹם תַּנִּ֑ים וַתְּכַ֖ס עָלֵ֣ינוּ בְצַלְמָֽוֶת׃

controles.web: Though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
controles.kjv: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
controles.livre: Tu tens nos afligido num lugar de chacais, e nos cobriste com sobra de morte.

versos.hebraico: אִם־שָׁ֭כַחְנוּ שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַנִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּ֝פֵּ֗ינוּ לְאֵ֣ל זָֽר׃

controles.web: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god;
controles.kjv: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
controles.livre: Se tivéssemos esquecido do nome do nosso Deus, e estendido nossas mãos a um outro deus,

versos.hebraico: הֲלֹ֣א אֱ֭לֹהִים יַֽחֲקָר־זֹ֑את כִּֽי־ה֥וּא יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ תַּעֲלֻמ֥וֹת לֵֽב׃

controles.web: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
controles.kjv: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
controles.livre: por acaso Deus não o descobriria? Pois ele conhece os segredos do coração.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־עָ֭לֶיךָ הֹרַ֣גְנוּ כָל־הַיּ֑וֹם נֶ֝חְשַׁ֗בְנוּ כְּצֹ֣אן טִבְחָֽה׃

controles.web: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
controles.kjv: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
controles.livre: Mas por causa de ti somos mortos o dia todo; somos considerados como ovelhas para o matadouro.

versos.hebraico: ע֤וּרָה׀ לָ֖מָּה תִישַׁ֥ן׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י הָ֝קִ֗יצָה אַל־תִּזְנַ֥ח לָנֶֽצַח׃

controles.web: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
controles.kjv: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
controles.livre: Desperta; por que estás dormindo, Senhor? Acorda, não nos rejeites para sempre.

versos.hebraico: לָֽמָּה־פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח עָנְיֵ֣נוּ וְֽלַחֲצֵֽנוּ׃

controles.web: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
controles.kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
controles.livre: Por que escondes tua face, e te esqueces de nossa humilhação e de nossa opressão?

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י שָׁ֣חָה לֶעָפָ֣ר נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ דָּבְקָ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ בִּטְנֵֽנוּ׃

controles.web: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
controles.kjv: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
controles.livre: Pois nossa alma está abatida ao pó; nosso ventre está junto à terra.

versos.hebraico: ק֭וּמָֽה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לָּ֑נוּ וּ֝פְדֵ֗נוּ לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
controles.kjv: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.
controles.livre: Levanta-te para nosso socorro; e resgata-nos por tua bondade.
